SELECT sum(try_cast(dep AS double)) AS deposits_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20241231'
Which agencies pass the most federal awards on to the organisations they fund?
SELECT passthrough_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_passthrough WHERE passthrough_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many substations operate at 500 kilovolts or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations WHERE try_cast(max_volt AS double) >= 500
Which buyers purchased the most wholesale electricity in 2023?

SELECT customer_company_name, round(sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2023%' AND product_name = 'ENERGY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem bioassays are confirmatory tests?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN aid2activityoutcomemethod = 'Confirmatory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod
How are GDB-11's molecules spread across sizes, by number of heavy atoms?
SELECT heavy_atoms, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11 WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who is listed as the chief officer of Cornell University?
SELECT instnm, chfnm, chftitle FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE instnm LIKE 'Cornell University%' LIMIT 5
Which sources have deposited the most substances in PubChem?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many coal-fired units reported to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which grid operators exported the most electricity to their neighbours in 2023?
SELECT balancing_authority, sum(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double)) AS net_export_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug mechanisms in ChEMBL involve inhibiting the target?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type = 'INHIBITOR'
Which states have the most tax-exempt organisations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York City's highest hourly electricity load in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which patents have been asserted in the most lawsuits?
SELECT patent, count(DISTINCT case_row_id) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_patents WHERE patent <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people live in New York City, by the 2025 estimate for cities?
SELECT try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND name = 'New York city' AND stname = 'New York'
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wind turbines went into service each year from 2013 to 2022?
SELECT p_year, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(p_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which utilities earned the most revenue from commercial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(revenues_1 AS double) AS commercial_thousand_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median age of people living in Maine?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US23' AND variable = 'B01002_E001'
Which metro areas have the largest share of residents aged 65 and over?

SELECT name, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) >= 14 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END) / sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) = 0 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END), 1) AS pct_65_plus FROM govblock_census.popest_cbsa_est_alldata_char WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many plant patent applications are on file?
SELECT count(*) AS plant_applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE invention_type = 'PLT'
In which large cities do the most people work from home?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E017' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_work_from_home FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '1600000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b08006' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NRC event reports were declared an Alert or a more serious emergency?
SELECT count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications WHERE emergency_class IN ('ALERT', 'SITE AREA EMERGENCY', 'GENERAL EMERGENCY')
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How long does a patent case last on average, from filing to closing?
SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', try_cast(date_filed AS date), try_cast(date_closed AS date)))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE date_closed IS NOT NULL
Which states have the most citizens of voting age?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities in New York State reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _8_st = 'NY'
Which reactors were shut down for the longest stretch in 2022?
SELECT trim(unit) AS unit, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2022 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many adverse drug event reports received in 2019 involved a death?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE seriousnessdeath = '1' AND substr(receivedate, 1, 4) = '2019'
Which New York counties drew the most federal assistance in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT recipient_county_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicaid pay for Humira prescriptions in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND state = 'XX' AND product_name LIKE 'HUMIRA%'
What products are sold under wholesale electricity contracts?
SELECT product_name, count(*) AS contract_lines FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many arXiv preprints later appeared with a journal reference?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE coalesce(journal_ref, '') <> ''
Which companies are named as owner on the most trademark filings?
SELECT own_name, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
